**Description & Requirements**
Bloomberg AIM (Asset and Investment Manager) is a buy-side trading platform used by some of the biggest asset managers in capital markets. Our platform is a one-stop shop that enables everything from idea generation to trade execution and post-trade operations. It’s a large scale system – built by more than 400 engineers – used to manage trillions of dollars each day by 930 global firms across over 80 countries. We’re the market leading platform, and Bloomberg continues to invest in our growth as a product and engineering team – that’s where you come in!
  
  
**Our Team**
In the Compliance team, we tackle problems associated with large distributed systems such as latency and scaling, balanced with the need for reliability and accuracy required for a business-critical system. Over the next 2-3 years, we have multiple projects focused on keeping our clients ahead of the competition as well as organically rebuilding the platform in order to serve the growing number of tier-1 clients with a global footprint that transact in volumes we currently cannot support. Solving problems on this scale is hard and we’re always looking for fresh ideas and new technologies to leverage.
  
  
**What’s in it for you?**
The Compliance team builds systems which ensure that every transaction happening across the entire AIM platform is checked against 10s of thousands of rules. These rules ensure that no market regulation is violated, no illicit/manipulative activity is performed, and no activity that would put the client at financial risk takes place. We additionally provide the necessary tools to define and manage rules as well as deal with violations and provide trading supervisory overrides where applicable. Because our systems are in the critical path of real-time trading, throughput, latency and correctness are of paramount importance.
  
  
The impact of the Compliance product spans further than just AIM as it is also being used by the Sell-Side OMS (TOMS), various execution platforms and portfolio optimizers. The team is a core team under Compliance providing a solution for Creation, Business intelligence, Audit, Reporting, and Automation of Compliance Rules. Our team works closely with our business counterparts and quality engineering teams in an Agile environment. Our development processes include daily scrum, sprint planning, Github, developing unit/regression tests, conducting code reviews and automated coverage tests and CI/CD pipeline.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a strong background in system design, architecture, and the development of high-quality, modular, stable, and scalable software. * Partner with product managers, quantitative analysts, and infrastructure engineers to deliver measurable business value

* Experience building scalable systems with focus on code quality, system telemetry, and testing
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* A self-starter approach with a strong sense of ownership

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Data Engineer
  
  
**Overview**
We are the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, a technology innovation lab, and the home of Priceless®. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. We believe in connecting everyone to endless, priceless possibilities.
  
  
**Our Team Within Mastercard – Data & Services**
The Data & Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that are used by some of the world's largest organizations to make multi-million dollar decisions and grow their businesses. Focused on thinking big and scaling fast around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business Test & Learn experimentation, and data-driven information and risk management services.
  
  
**Data Analytics And AI Solutions (DAAI) Program**
Within the D&S Technology Team, the DAAI program is a relatively new program that is comprised of a rich set of products that provide accurate perspectives on Portfolio Optimization, and Ad Insights. Currently, we are enhancing our customer experience with new user interfaces, moving to API and web application-based data publishing to allow for seamless integration in other Mastercard products and externally, utilizing new data sets and algorithms to further analytic capabilities, and generating scalable big data processes.
  
  
We are looking for an innovative software engineering lead who will lead the technical design and development of an Analytic Foundation. The Analytic Foundation is a suite of individually commercialized analytical capabilities (think prediction as a service, matching as a service or forecasting as a service) that also includes a comprehensive data platform. These services will be offered through a series of APIs that deliver data and insights from various points along a central data store. This individual will partner closely with other areas of the business to build and enhance solutions that drive value for our customers.
  
  
Engineers work in small, flexible teams. Every team member contributes to designing, building, and testing features. The range of work you will encounter varies from building intuitive, responsive UIs to designing backend data models, architecting data flows, and beyond. There are no rigid organizational structures, and each team uses processes that work best for its members and projects.
  
  
Here are a few examples of products in our space:
  
  
Portfolio Optimizer (PO) is a solution that leverages Mastercard’s data assets and analytics to allow issuers to identify and increase revenue opportunities within their credit and debit portfolios.
  
  
Ad Insights uses anonymized and aggregated transaction insights to offer targeting segments that have high likelihood to make purchases within a category to allow for more effective campaign planning and activation.
  
  
Help found a new, fast-growing engineering team!
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:
  
  
Play a large role in scoping, design and implementation of complex features
  
  
Push the boundaries of analytics and powerful, scalable applications
  
  
Design and implement intuitive, responsive UIs that allow issuers to better understand data and analytics
  
  
Build and maintain analytics and data models to enable performant and scalable products
  
  
Ensure a high-quality code base by writing and reviewing performant, well-tested code
  
  
Mentor junior software engineers and teammates
  
  
Drive innovative improvements to team development processes
  
  
Partner with Product Managers and Customer Experience Designers to develop a deep understanding of users and use cases and apply that knowledge to scoping and building new modules and features
  
  
Collaborate across teams with exceptional peers who are passionate about what they do
  
  
**Ideal Candidate Qualifications**
7+ years of full stack engineering experience in an agile production environment
  
  
Experience leading the design and implementation of large, complex features in full-stack applications
  
  
Ability to easily move between business, data management, and technical teams; ability to quickly intuit the business use case and identify technical solutions to enable it
  
  
Experience leveraging open source tools, predictive analytics, machine learning, Advanced Statistics, and other data techniques to perform analyses
  
  

* High proficiency in using Python or Scala, Spark, Hadoop platforms & tools (Hive, Impala, Airflow, NiFi, Scoop), SQL to build Big Data products & platforms
* Experience in building and deploying production-level data-driven applications and data processing workflows/pipelines and/or implementing machine learning systems at scale in Java, Scala, or Python and deliver analytics involving all phases like data ingestion, feature engineering, modeling, tuning, evaluating, monitoring, and presenting

Experience coaching and mentoring junior teammates
  
  
Experience leading a large technical effort that spans multiple people and teams
  
  
Proficiency with Java/Spring Boot, .NET/C#, React, Redux, Typescript, and SQL Server or other object-oriented languages, front-end frameworks, and/or relational database technologies
  
  
Strong technologist with proven track record of learning new technologies and frameworks
  
  
Customer-centric development approach
  
  
Passion for analytical / quantitative problem solving
  
  
Experience identifying and implementing technical improvements to development processes
  
  
Collaboration skills with experience working with people across roles and geographies
  
  
Motivation, creativity, self-direction, and desire to thrive on small project teams
  
  
Superior academic record with a degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  
  
Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior AI/DS Engineer
description:
**Designation :**
Senior AI/DS Engineer

**Required Experience:**

5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership.

**Job Description:**

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production.

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

:

**1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -**

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria.

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs.

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach.

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications.

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement.

**2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership**

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring.

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern.

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices.

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimisation while enabling the team to execute independently.

**3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows**

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate.

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation.

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior.

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed.

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops.

**4. Applied machine learning and data science**

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization.

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly.

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data.

● Guide specialist computer-vision, OCR/intelligent document processing or multimodal work when required by the project portfolio; deep specialist research methods are not a blanket requirement for this role.

**5. Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps**

●Build or guide production services and integrations using Python and REST APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), with appropriate validation, authentication, error handling, testing and documentation.

●Deploy and operate solutions in AWS or the agreed cloud platform. Relevant AWS services may include S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, RDS, Glue, EventBridge, Redshift, Lambda and container/orchestration services, depending on the architecture.

●Implement or oversee CI/CD, containerization, environment management, model/prompt/version tracking, automated tests, release controls, rollback and operational handover.

●Monitor application health and business/model quality, including latency, throughput, availability, cost, token consumption, retrieval quality, feedback signals and model/data drift where applicable.

● Own incident triage and root-cause analysis with engineering/platform teams; define fallback paths and support processes for customer-facing AI capabilities.

**6. Delivery management and stakeholder alignment**

●Own the delivery plan from discovery to launch: estimates, milestones, sprint/backlog priorities, resource needs, dependencies, risks, testing, UAT, release readiness and transition to support.

●Maintain a clear decision, action and risk log; provide concise progress updates; escalate issues early and propose options instead of only reporting blockers.

●Coordinate across customer teams, product/business analysts, data engineering, software engineering, QA, cloud/DevOps, security and domain experts.

●Ensure acceptance criteria and agreed business outcomes are met, and capture lessons learned and post-launch improvements

title: Senior Business and Data Analyst
description:
**About Us**
Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.
  
  
As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.
  
  
Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Business and Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you'll be the analytical engine between a client's business need and the data solution that delivers it. You'll turn business questions into precise, testable requirements, then use the data itself to prove out what's possible: profiling sources, validating assumptions, and shaping designs that are clean, buildable, and grounded in evidence rather than opinion. You'll own the requirements and analysis for your use cases and workstreams, working in close partnership with Business Solution Managers who hold the broader engagement.
  
  
Doing that well takes two things at once: command of healthcare business context, and deep, hands-on fluency in the data. This is a client-facing role. You'll translate complex healthcare challenges into rigorous requirements, and you'll use SQL and analytical judgment to show clients and delivery teams what the data actually says, where it falls short, and what that means for the design.
  
  
No engagement lives in isolation. A data model built for one client's use case can share structure with a completely different client's need; a transformation rule written for one state's requirements often anticipates the next state's. You'll learn to see each requirement as part of a larger system of clients, states, use cases, and data flows, and to flag where a design can be reused or where it could collide with other work.
  
  
Our clients are US health plans and the partners who serve them, and the engagements span everything it takes to make their data usable. That can mean standardizing and migrating data onto a new platform, meeting evolving regulatory and compliance mandates, or powering the broader analytics and reporting programs that drive payer performance across Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial lines of business.
  
  
**Your day to day**
**Analyze the Data and Build the Evidence**

* Write and execute SQL daily to profile source data, test assumptions, quantify data quality (completeness, validity, uniqueness, consistency, timeliness), and prototype logic before it reaches the build team.
* Analyze source data to establish what is actually available and reliable: field population and distributions, key integrity, duplicates, outliers, and gaps against what the business use case needs.
* Reconcile and validate outputs against source systems and client-provided benchmarks (claim counts, member months, paid amounts, enrollment spans, provider rosters), investigating variances to root cause and documenting findings.
* Define and document business metrics and KPIs precisely: numerator, denominator, inclusion and exclusion logic, time basis, and grain, so every consumer of the data calculates and reads them the same way.
* Perform exploratory and root-cause analysis on client questions and data anomalies, and turn findings into clear, quantified recommendations for client and internal audiences.
* Summarize findings through data profiling reports, analysis readouts, and visualizations that make the story clear to non-technical stakeholders.

**Drive Requirements And Design For Your Use Cases**

* Lead discovery sessions for your use cases, and support broader engagement-level sessions alongside the Business Solution Manager, to understand the why and what behind each use case: the business context, pain points, expected outcomes, and success criteria, rather than just the surface-level data ask.
* Translate each use case into clear, testable requirements, including success criteria and non-functional requirements, and maintain traceability from business need to requirement to design to test.
* Use data analysis to sharpen and challenge requirements: confirm that what the client is asking for is supported by the data they have, and surface gaps early.
* Document source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, and business rules that developers can build from, and define the test conditions and expected results QA will use to validate them.
* Recommend the appropriate grain and structure of a dataset given the business context, and analyze how that grain decision ripples into the downstream reports, models, or programs that consume the data.
* Identify dependencies before a design is finalized: which other workstreams, reports, or client use cases touch this same data, and how a change here could break or benefit them, escalating cross-workstream impacts to the Business Solution Manager.
* Apply systems thinking: recognize when a design built for one client, state, or use case can become a reusable pattern, and raise and shape that reuse rather than discovering it in hindsight.

**Be a Trusted Client-Facing Partner**

* Drive requirements-gathering and clarification conversations with client SMEs for your use cases, since incomplete or poorly elicited requirements undermine everything built downstream.
* Present analysis results, data quality findings, and recommendations to client stakeholders with clarity and confidence, and guide decisions with evidence.
* Represent client intent for your use cases through delivery and serve as a day-to-day point of contact, with the Business Solution Manager owning the overall client relationship.
* Translate fluently between business and technical audiences, so both sides share the same understanding.

**Collaborate Across Delivery**

* Connect the client and the internal team on your workstreams, holding the business context, data findings, and design drivers that shape the build.
* Act as the business and data analysis SME for Solution Architects, Product, QA, Account Management, and Program Management, giving them clean hand-offs with the context, business rules, and analysis they need to execute without rework or reinterpretation.
* Support QA and UAT by supplying validation queries, expected results, and variance analysis, and by helping triage defects to business rule, mapping, or source data causes.
* Maintain awareness of the wider engagement: understand how a decision made for one workstream affects the others, and flag those ripple effects before they surface as rework.

**What You Bring To The Team**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5+ years working in the US healthcare domain and with healthcare data (claims, provider, membership/eligibility, benefits, prior authorization, or PBM).
* Payer experience required: direct experience working with or for a US health plan (Medicare, Medicaid, or Commercial), whether in-house or through healthcare consulting.
* Working command of core payer concepts such as membership/enrollment, provider, claims, and authorizations, enough to reason about business context rather than specialize narrowly in any one area.
* Strong, hands-on SQL: comfortable with joins across large, multi-table datasets, window functions, CTEs, aggregations, and date/span logic, used regularly to profile, validate, reconcile, and analyze data.
* Demonstrated analytical rigor: a track record of profiling data, assessing data quality, investigating anomalies to root cause, and communicating quantified findings that drove a decision.
* Experience defining metrics, mentoring junior analysts, and eliciting and authoring business requirements in complex, data-driven environments.
* Confident client-facing communication; able to drive a conversation, elicit requirements clearly, and present analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and re-prioritizing frequently while managing multiple use cases within a larger engagement.
* Developing systems thinking: experience designing for reuse and scale across states, clients, or use cases rather than solving each case in isolation, and the ability to trace how a requirement or data model decision affects other parts of a larger data ecosystem.

**What We Would Like To See, But Not Required**

* Exposure to Databricks or Snowflake
* Experience with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to communicate analysis.
* Familiarity with HEDIS and Stars quality reporting, risk adjustment, payment integrity, value-based care analytics, provider data management, or CMS interoperability (CMS-0057).
* Working knowledge of data modeling concepts, including how the grain and structure of a dataset shape its downstream use.
* Familiarity with Python or similar for analysis and automation.

**Compensation**
Compensation for this role is based on experience, skills, and location, and includes base salary plus eligibility for performance bonuses and equity grants.
  
  
**What You’ll Get In Return**

* Competitive Leave & Benefits
* Comprehensive health coverage
* Equity for every employee – share in our success
* Growth-focused environment – your development matters here

**Work arrangements**

* Standard hours: 9 hours/day, 5 days/week
* Location: Pune, Onsite (1 PM - 10 PM IST)
* Shift: Your standard working hours will be nine (9) hours per day within the Company’s standard working hours. Specific working hours may vary based on business needs.

**Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer**
As a mission-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. Therefore, we dedicate resources to building diverse teams and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. Abacus prohibits discrimination and harassment regarding race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
At the heart of who we are is a commitment to continuously and intentionally building an inclusive culture—one that empowers every team member across the globe to do their best work and bring their authentic selves. We carry that same commitment into our hiring process, aiming to create an interview experience where you feel comfortable and confident showcasing your strengths. If there’s anything we can do to support that—big or small—please let us know.
  
  
**AI Use in Recruitment**

title: Data Scientist – AI Modelling (3 -5 years only)
description:
**About The Role**
The FCC DnA team is seeking an experienced Data Scientist to join our AI Modeling team and develop scalable Machine Learning, statistical and AI solutions.
  
  
This role is ideal for a hands-on Data Scientist who can independently translate business problems into modeling problems, evaluate multiple analytical approaches and recommend solutions based on data, statistical evidence and business requirements.
  
  
You will work across Statistical Modeling, Machine Learning, NLP and Generative AI while partnering with Product, Engineering and Business teams to take solutions from experimentation toward production.
  
  
We are looking for someone who goes beyond building a model and can clearly explain why a particular modeling approach was selected, how it was validated and what its limitations are.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Translate business problems and requirements into appropriate analytical and modeling approaches.
* Independently design, develop and evaluate statistical and Machine Learning models.
* Establish appropriate baseline and challenger models and objectively compare alternative approaches.
* Perform exploratory analysis, feature engineering, feature selection and data-quality assessment.
* Define appropriate model evaluation metrics based on the business problem and the cost of different types of errors.
* Apply cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, out-of-sample testing and other robust validation techniques.
* Conduct detailed error analysis, sensitivity analysis and model diagnostics.
* Identify and address issues such as data leakage, class imbalance, multicollinearity, sampling bias and overfitting.
* Evaluate model explainability, stability and performance trade-offs.
* Clearly document model methodology, assumptions, limitations and validation results.
* Partner with Engineering and MLOps teams to transition models from experimentation into production.
* Support model monitoring, performance tracking and drift analysis after deployment.
* Build reusable modeling components and frameworks that can be leveraged across multiple use cases.
* Contribute to NLP, Generative AI, RAG and hybrid AI solutions where appropriate.
* Mentor junior Data Scientists and conduct code and model reviews.
* Communicate modeling recommendations and trade-offs effectively to business, Product and technical stakeholders.

**Experience**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Approximately 3-5 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistical Modeling or Applied AI.
* Demonstrated experience independently developing and validating predictive models.
* Experience working across the model development lifecycle from data exploration through validation and productionization.
* Experience working with cross-functional Product, Engineering and Business teams.

Statistical & Modeling Skills
  
  

* Strong understanding of statistical inference, probability, hypothesis testing and experimental design.
* Strong hands-on experience with regression, classification, tree-based models, ensemble methods and other Machine Learning techniques.
* Experience with algorithms such as logistic/linear regression, random forest, gradient boosting, XGBoost/LightGBM or comparable techniques.
* Strong understanding of feature engineering, feature selection and model diagnostics.
* Experience designing benchmark, baseline and challenger models.
* Strong understanding of model evaluation and the ability to select metrics appropriate to the business problem.
* Understanding of bias-variance trade-offs, sampling bias, class imbalance, data leakage and model stability.
* Experience with explainability techniques such as feature importance, SHAP or similar approaches.
* Ability to assess trade-offs between predictive performance, interpretability, complexity and maintainability.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong Python and modern Data Science ecosystem experience.
* Strong SQL and data manipulation skills.
* Experience developing production-quality, reusable modeling code.
* Familiarity with APIs and frameworks such as FastAPI.
* Familiarity with Git, Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms such as Azure/AWS and MLOps practices.
* Experience with model deployment, monitoring and versioning is preferred.
* Experience with NLP, Generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, RAG or Agentic AI is desirable and will enable contribution across broader AI initiatives.

We Are Looking for Individuals Who
  
  

* Ask which modeling approach is most appropriate for the problem and can explain why.
* Challenge assumptions rather than automatically selecting the most complex algorithm.
* Are comfortable working with ambiguous business problems and defining a structured analytical approach.
* Balance experimentation with analytical rigor and production considerations.
* Take ownership of modeling workstreams and independently drive them to completion.
* Clearly articulate model performance, assumptions, limitations and business implications.
* Mentor junior team members and raise the quality of modeling practices around them.
* Collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering and business stakeholders.
* Remain current with developments across statistical modeling, Machine Learning and broader Applied AI.

Education
  
  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Economics or another quantitative discipline.

title: Consultant — Analytics
description:
**Consultant — Analytics
  
  
Level:**
4–6 year's experience
**Location:**
Gurgaon/ Pune
  
  
Blue Matter Consulting (BMI) is a rapidly growing management consultancy focused on the biopharmaceutical industry. We partner with life sciences companies to commercialize therapies that extend and improve human life — translating data and insights into strategies that matter.
  
  
We operate across seven global offices with an entrepreneurial culture built on curiosity, integrity, and collective excellence. Consultants at BMI are trusted leaders — the engine of client relationships, the architects of analytical frameworks, and the coaches who develop the next generation of BMI talent.
  
  
**Our Core Values — The Foundation Of How We Work**
At BMI, values are the operating system behind every deliverable, every client conversation, and every promotion decision. As a consultant, you are not only expected to live these values — you are expected to model and multiply them across your team.
  
  
**Speak the TRUTH —**
*"True to the data; true to the client"*
We let the data lead. Our recommendations are grounded in evidence, and when analysis contradicts expectations, we say so with clarity and respect.
**Solve for SO WHAT —**
*"Be the client, own the impact"*
Every analysis we deliver connects to a real business need. We dig past the technical ask to understand the underlying question — and hold ourselves to delivering meaningful impact, not just outputs.
**Stay CURIOUS —**
*"Dig deeper, see further to innovate"*
Curiosity is our superpower. We ask 'why' continuously, build T-shaped expertise across data, analytics, and business context, and embrace new tools and methods to solve old problems in better ways.
**Win TOGETHER —**
*"Individually experts; collectively transformative"*
We encourage every voice regardless of level, hold each other accountable, and step up when it counts — across time zones and across teams.
  
  
***The Role***
As a Consultant at Blue Matter, you are the connective tissue between data and decision. You lead client-facing analytical engagements end-to-end, own the quality and strategic coherence of every deliverable on your projects, and serve as a trusted advisor to pharma and biotech clients navigating critical commercial challenges.
  
  
This is a role for someone who has moved well beyond execution. You shape the analytical approach, challenge the brief when necessary, mentor junior colleagues, and ensure BMI's four core values are embedded in how your team works — not just what it produces.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
You will lead end-to-end delivery of analytics engagements while building lasting client relationships and developing your team. Your responsibilities span client leadership, analytical excellence, and people development:
  
  
**Lead with intellectual depth**

* Set the research and analytical agenda for engagements: define which questions matter most and the most rigorous methods to answer them
* Stay at the forefront of life sciences commercial trends, data ecosystems, and emerging analytical tools — and actively bring that knowledge into client engagements
* Challenge assumptions in the brief, push past the obvious, and look around corners to surface insights clients haven't yet asked for but need
* Foster a culture of curiosity on your team — coach analysts and associate consultants to ask better questions before they build models

**Be the voice clients trust**

* Own the integrity of all analytical outputs on your engagements — ensure every recommendation is backed by rigorous evidence, not narrative convenience
* Deliver difficult findings to senior client stakeholders with confidence, clarity, and respect — including when data contradicts the client's hypothesis or internal position
* Model radical candor internally: give direct, constructive feedback to junior colleagues and create an environment where concerns surface early
* Do the right thing — flag risks, escalate issues, and never sell a project you know won't add value to the client

**Architect impact, not just analysis**

* Lead the design of analytical frameworks and custom solutions that address clients' underlying commercial challenges — not just their stated technical ask
* Before scoping any engagement, ask: 'How will this analysis change the client's strategy?' Ensure scope serves impact, not the other way around
* Develop and apply advanced statistical models, forecasting frameworks, segmentation analyses, and market models using Excel/VBA, Python, R, SQL, Alteryx, and visualization platforms (Tableau, Qlik, PowerPoint)
* Translate complex quantitative outputs into crisp executive narratives — from model to boardroom in one coherent story
* Mentor associates on moving from technical execution to strategic thinking: coaching them to ask 'So what does this mean for the client?' at every step

**Lead the team, build the partnership**

* Serve as the primary day-to-day client contact: build trusted relationships across functional levels and ensure BMI is experienced as a strategic partner, not a vendor
* Lead cross-functional, globally distributed project teams - actively bridge onshore and offshore colleagues so every team member is a full contributor, not just an executor
* Invest in junior talent: coach analysts and associate consultants through regular feedback, stretch assignments, and honest conversations about their growth
* Invite dissent and junior voices into project reviews — the best idea wins, regardless of who had it
* Step in for teammates when the team needs it; never let a deliverable fail for lack of support

**Required**
***What You'll Bring***

* 4-6 years of experience in analytics, data science, or management consulting - ideally with direct exposure to pharma or biotech commercial challenges
* Advanced proficiency across multiple analytical tools: SQL, Python/R, Excel/VBA, Alteryx, or equivalent
* Demonstrated ability to lead analytical engagements independently - from scoping and methodology design through to client delivery
* Track record of translating complex quantitative analysis into clear, high-impact recommendations for senior stakeholders
* Experience managing or mentoring junior team members in a professional setting
* Excellent communication and client relationship skills; comfortable leading conversations with leadership level client contacts
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and deliver quality work

**Preferred**

* Deep expertise in one or more life sciences commercial domains: launch analytics, patient analytics, market forecasting, field force optimization, pricing and access, or medical affairs analytics
* Experience with secondary data sources common in pharma (IQVIA, Symphony Health, Komodo, APLD, or equivalent)
* Advanced proficiency in Tableau, Qlik, or Power BI for client-facing dashboards and tools
* BE/BTech/BS in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* MTech/MS in Statistics, Data Science, or MBA from a reputable institution is a strong plus

**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
A strong Consultant at BMI will:
  
  

* Be trusted by clients to lead the analytical conversation - and by BMI leadership to scope, staff, and deliver engagements with minimal oversight
* Consistently deliver findings that challenge comfortable assumptions and earn client respect for the quality and integrity of BMI's work
* Be known internally as someone who elevates the analytical bar - always asking the next question, always pushing for a deeper answer
* Have a direct, positive impact on at least one junior team member's growth — measured not by output volume, but by the quality of their thinking

***Why Blue Matter***

* Lead high-stakes analytics engagements that directly influence commercialization decisions for therapies in oncology, rare diseases, immunology, and beyond
* Operate as a trusted partner. BMI's client relationships are deep, long-term, and built on the quality of our thinking
* Shape the next generation of BMI talent: Consultants are coaches, not just contributors
* Clear path to Lead and Partner — merit-driven, transparent, and fast for those who exemplify the BMI values.

* Experience with messaging and streaming systems such as Kafka, and with designing resilient, idempotent, event-driven architectures.
* Strong grounding in microservices, REST/gRPC API design, and distributed systems fundamentals (consistency, partitioning, fault tolerance).
* Experience with cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), and owning CI/CD pipelines.

* Proven ability to lead technical work across multiple teams, influence architectural decisions without direct authority, and mentor senior engineers.
* Clear communicator who can explain complex technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience in ad tech (programmatic advertising, RTB, DSP/SSP systems) or healthcare data platforms is a plus.
* Experience building production LLM features, including guardrails, cost and latency optimisation, and observability for AI workloads, is a plus.
* Familiarity with big data processing frameworks such as Spark or Flink is a plus.

title: Full Stack Product Engineer (100% Remote India)
description:
**Help build the open future of digital intelligence**
At InnoCraft (trading as Matomo), we believe everyone has the right to data sovereignty, privacy and trusted analytics insights.
  
  
Born from open source and backed by a global community, Matomo helps organisations understand their users and digital performance without surrendering ownership, privacy or control of their data.
  
  
Today, Matomo is used on more than one million websites across 190 countries, supporting leading brands, national governments, universities and organisations in regulated industries.
  
  
We are looking for a Product Engineer to help organisations make sense of their digital performance as AI changes how people discover and interact with them. You’ll help decide which problems matter most, shape solutions and deliver software that gives customers clearer insights while protecting their privacy and ownership of their data. Working closely with Product and your engineering team, you’ll have the trust and responsibility to take ideas through to measurable customer outcomes.
  
  
This is an opportunity to take real ownership, solve challenging product and platform problems, and see your work make a difference in a widely used open-source product.
  
  
**Why this role matters**
Customers need confidence in their data, a clear understanding of their users and tools that help them act on what they learn. As digital behaviour changes, Matomo needs to meet those needs while remaining accessible to smaller organisations and capable enough for demanding enterprise use.
  
  
Our Product Engineering teams focus on five domains:
**Measurement Integrity, Human Analytics, AI Analytics & Digital Presence, Growth & Web, and Enterprise Platform**
. You’ll work within one of these domains, collaborating across teams where customer problems and technical decisions overlap.
  
  
You’ll build new capabilities and improve a mature, widely used product. That means understanding existing systems, choosing practical solutions and evolving Matomo with care for the customers, open-source users, integrations and plugins that depend on it.]
  
  
Your work will directly influence:
  
  

* The accuracy and trustworthiness of the data customers use to make decisions.
* How clearly customers understand human behaviour and their digital presence as AI changes how people discover and interact with them.
* How easily customers get started, find value and grow their use of Matomo.
* How effectively enterprise customers manage access, governance and integrations at scale.

We make extensive use of approved AI tools throughout our engineering workflow, from exploring ideas and prototyping to building, reviewing and testing software. We expect you to use them to move faster and improve quality, while applying your own judgement and taking responsibility for the decisions you make and the software you ship.
  
  
**What you’ll own**

* Understand the problem. Work with Product, colleagues and customers to uncover needs, question assumptions and agree what a useful outcome looks like.
* Shape the solution. Explore options, test ideas through prototypes and make clear trade-offs about scope, complexity and what to deliver first.
* Build across the stack. Own the technical design and implementation, choosing practical solutions that fit the product and its existing systems.
* Build quality in from the start. Work with QA and Design as needed, considering privacy, security, accessibility, performance and compatibility throughout delivery.
* Deliver and learn. Ship in small increments, take responsibility for how your changes work in production, and use customer feedback and evidence to measure results and improve them.
* Use AI effectively throughout delivery. Give tools the context they need, challenge their suggestions and verify the results. Keep privacy, security and maintainability central to the work you ship.

**What you bring**

* 5+ years experience delivering full-stack software, with the technical depth to investigate difficult problems and make sound design decisions.
* Product judgement and a drive to solve real customer problems. You can explain why a change is worth building and care whether people use and benefit from it.
* Confidence taking ownership of outcomes, clarifying problems and shaping solutions without needing every requirement spelled out in a ticket.
* Confidence working in mature systems, understanding existing behaviour and improving it without unnecessary rewrites.
* The ability to balance delivery speed with quality, privacy, security and backwards compatibility.
* Strong experience using AI throughout development: refining requirements, preparing clear context for prompts, building and testing solutions, and checking the results. You keep reusable AI skills and instructions up to date, follow developments in models and tools, and experiment with new ways to improve delivery and quality.
* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly in a global, asynchronous environment
* A strong record of taking ownership, exercising sound judgement and delivering measurable outcomes

**Helpful experience**

* You are happy working wherever the problem takes you: frontend, backend, databases, APIs, product flows, documentation, or customer feedback.
* Our stack includes PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Vue.js, and TypeScript. Exact stack experience is useful, but not required. We care more about your ability to learn, reason, ship, and solve meaningful problems.
* Experience in product management, UI/UX design or building your own product or business.
* Contributing to or maintaining open-source projects, or building plugins, APIs and integrations used across different environments.
* Analytics, data-intensive systems or enterprise software.

You may not match every item, but you should bring strong capability in the core requirements and a clear record of creating meaningful impact.
  
  
**Why Matomo?**
Matomo is for people who want their work to matter.
  
  
You will help build technology that protects data privacy, strengthens digital sovereignty and gives organisations a genuine alternative to surveillance-based platforms.
  
  
We are intentionally lean, globally distributed and backed by a worldwide open-source community. Important work is not buried under layers. You will have access to meaningful problems, the context behind decisions and the opportunity to influence what Matomo becomes next.
  
  
We value people who take ownership, exercise strong judgement and turn complex problems into clear, valuable outcomes. People who raise standards, challenge assumptions and care about the complete result, not only their part of it.
  
  
High performance at Matomo means choosing the work that matters most, moving it forward with urgency and leaving customers, colleagues and Matomo stronger because of your contribution.
  
  
You will have freedom over where and, within the needs of your role, when you work. In return, we expect clear communication, dependable follow-through and accountability for outcomes.
  
  
We also protect focused work through:
  
  

* No-meeting Fridays
* No more than two days each week with late meetings
* No meetings after 10pm in any time zone

This is a place for people who want meaningful responsibility, visible impact and the opportunity to help build something globally significant.
  
  
**Benefits**

* 100% remote working within your country of employment
* Flexible working hours, within the collaboration and coverage requirements of the role
* 25 days of paid annual leave
* Home-office equipment allowance
* Health insurance support, where applicable
* Mental-health and wellbeing support
* Paid volunteering day
* Pet bereavement leave

Benefits vary depending on the country of employment.
  
  
**Hiring Process**
Application → Screening → Online aptitude test → People & Culture interview → Hiring Manager/Behaviour interview→ Live Coding test (Final round)
  
  
**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
Matomo values what makes you unique. We’re an inclusive employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, because diverse perspectives help us build better products.
  
  
**Fight for data privacy. Build the open future of digital intelligence. Create meaningful impact from anywhere.**
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Java (Spring Boot)**
